systems.system: Prototype location addressing system (LAS) for Tlokweng village
systems.platform: Python, GeoPandas and a Django web application, deployed on Microsoft Windows
systems.tiers: A research prototype for one peri-urban village, tested by 42 participants including six from South-East District Council; not stated to be in use by any council

systems.system: Land Administration Procedures, Capacity and Systems (LAPCAS) project
systems.owner: Ministry of Lands and Housing with Lantmateriet, the Swedish mapping and land registration authority
systems.tiers: National; its location-addressing component was never implemented

note: A paper on street addressing, which it says is local government's statutory responsibility; the council staff appear only as survey participants, and nothing is stated about a council office's connection.
